title: Paraguay bank collapses with half of population’s savings
excerpt: Protests have erupted across Paraguay after Ueno Bank was shut down in the middle of the night over a solvency crisis.
content_html:
NewsFeed

Protests have erupted across Paraguay after Ueno Bank was shut down in the middle of the night over a solvency crisis, leaving customers unable to access their money. An estimated 60% of the adult population banks with Ueno.

Published On 5 Nov 2026
